_doc: The closed list of what may page the owner's phone through pager.py (item RIMMANDRAKE_DESIGN_PUSHOVER_ALERTS_CRITICAL_ONLY_TWO_SENDERS; design design/specs/2026-11-19-pushover-critical-alerts/design.md). A class not here cannot page him. Adding or changing a class is the Conductor's logged act: a commit from the Conductor window plus a ledger note with --per-ruling RIMMANDRAKE_ENACT_CONDUCTOR_MAY_DO_ALL_BUT_FIVE_ACTS; each entry's `added` names that act. window_h is the dedupe window: a repeat of the same class and cause inside it is recorded, not rung. Its danger: an alert that rings again for a fault he already knows trains him to ignore the pager (owner 2026-11-19: 'only for CRITICAL needs').

HARDWARE_FAILURE.label: Hardware failure
HARDWARE_FAILURE.means: a machine in the estate is failing or about to lose data: a fatal disk or PCIe error, SteveDesktop in a long fault, a disk about to fill

added.per: owner 2026-11-19 ~7:00 PM PST: 'only for CRITICAL needs like hardware failure'

ACCOUNT_SWITCH_FAILURE.label: Cannot switch accounts
ACCOUNT_SWITCH_FAILURE.means: the switching plan tried a switch and it failed, or the fleet is dark with no account to run on

added.per: owner 2026-11-19 ~7:00 PM PST: 'inability to switch accounts'

GOAL_SHOCK.label: A stated goal has failed
GOAL_SHOCK.means: the Conductor judges that a goal in infrastructure/state/CONDUCTOR_GOALS.md cannot be reached by the means it states, and he would want to know before his next sitting; never an ordinary miss or a late date

added.per: owner 2026-11-19 ~7:00 PM PST: 'shocking inability to achieve a stated goal'

TEST.label: Test page
TEST.means: the Conductor's drill that a page reaches his phone; window_h 0: a test never dedupes

added.per: the brief's 'one real test page' before any trigger is switched on
